text:
You need help keeping case files, paperwork, and client follow-ups organized so the firm can move work forward efficiently.

I have 5 years of experience in data analysis and admin-style support using Excel, SQL, Google Sheets, Power BI, and data cleaning. While my past project work was in a different industry, it required careful file preparation, structured tracking, and scenario-based analysis.

For Sunrise Dental Partners, I built a three-site expansion model in Excel with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing. The model compared 3 sites and showed the chosen site was projected to pay back in 14 months.

I’d bring that same attention to detail to maintaining files, completing paperwork, and following up with clients and service providers. I’m comfortable learning your case types and working accurately with clear procedures.
